# jt-portfolio

Jason Teixeira — AI Automation × QA / LLM-Eval engineer portfolio.
**The site runs its own QA**: the proof strip on the page is generated by this
repo's test suite, and CI blocks any push that breaks it. No fake green.

## Stack

Static HTML/CSS/JS — no framework, no build step for the page itself.
Content collections (projects, briefs, services, notes) live as data in
`assets/site.js` and `scripts/notes.data.mjs`, and are baked to static HTML
for SEO by the build scripts.

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `npm run serve` | Local dev server on :8242 |
| `npm test` | Playwright suite — smoke + axe a11y, desktop Chrome + mobile WebKit |
| `npm run proof` | Runs the suite and writes `proof/scorecard.json` (the on-page strip) |
| `npm run prerender` | Bakes JS-rendered collections into `index.html` (no-JS/SEO) |
| `npm run build:notes` | Generates `notes/*.html`, `field-notes.html`, `feed.xml`, `sitemap.xml`, `robots.txt` from `scripts/notes.data.mjs` |
| `node scripts/build-og.mjs` | Renders `assets/og.png` from the on-brand template |
| `npx lhci autorun` | Lighthouse budget (perf ≥.9 · a11y ≥.95 · bp ≥.9 · seo ≥.85) |

## Editing content

- **Projects / briefs / services / homepage notes list** → `assets/site.js`
  data arrays, then `npm run prerender && npm run proof`.
- **Field notes (blog)** → add an entry in `scripts/notes.data.mjs`, then
  `npm run build:notes && npm run prerender && npm run proof`.
- **Project walkthrough videos** → set `video: 'https://youtube.com/watch?v=…'`
  on a project in `assets/site.js`; replaces the "Private — walkthrough on
  request" label with a public ▶ link.
- **Availability chip** → hero section of `index.html` (`.avail-chip`).
- **Domain** → `scripts/site.config.mjs` `SITE_URL` (live at
  `agency.sageideas.dev`), then rebuild notes + prerender; also update
  the hardcoded head of `index.html`.

## CI

`.github/workflows/proof.yml` runs the Playwright suite and the Lighthouse
budget on every push/PR to main.
